title: Fig. 2 "Abort Procedures" diagram, Gemini GT-4 abort modes I, II, III
description: Diagram titled "ABORT PROCEDURES" showing altitude bands from sea level through 15,000 ft and 75,000 ft to orbital velocity, with launch vehicle and spacecraft figures, ejection-seat parachutes and a spacecraft parachute. A legend reads "MODE I - EJECT AFTER SHUTDOWN", "MODE II - SALVO RETROS AFTER SHUTDOWN" and "MODE III - SHUTDOWN, SEPARATE, TURN AROUND, RETROFIRE", with a "DELAYED MODE II" band and elapsed-time markers. Accompanying text (NASA M-913-65-04) describes unusual tasks of the GT-4 mission, the G4C suit and abort procedures. Captioned "FIG. 2".
